capabilities: Collect selected text into preset target notes via command, hotkey, context menu, or ribbon
Insert collected text at the end, start, or under a specified heading using custom templates
Undo the last collection by removing the exact inserted fragment
Track per-target collection statistics such as entry counts and last collection time
Restrict collection commands to specific folder paths using glob rules
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer; target notes must already exist since the plugin never creates notes. Reads selections only and never writes to the source note, rejecting collections that would target the same file.
intentEvidence: Similar plugins (Note Refactor, Note Composer, etc.) usually follow an extract-and-replace workflow that cuts text from the source note
motivation: The author built it for the copy-and-append need that extract-and-replace plugins like Note Refactor and Note Composer do not serve.
problem: Obsidian's extract-style plugins cut text out of the source note or replace it with a link, but collecting excerpts into another note without modifying the source has no dedicated workflow.

relations.evidence: Similar plugins (Note Refactor, Note Composer, etc.) usually follow an extract-and-replace workflow

summary: Copy-append collector that sends selected text from any note to preset target notes while leaving the source note untouched.
